script.code:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(n.t, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS db_now,
       CAST(j.id AS CHAR) AS id, j.organization_id, j.command, j.job_status, j.lease_owner, (j.lease_expires_at > n.t) AS lease_live, j.row_version,
       j.attempt_count, j.idempotency_key, j.correlation_id, j.request_payload, j.is_deleted,
       (SELECT CAST(MAX(g.id) AS CHAR) FROM sm_location_transfer g
         WHERE g.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_LPguard.data.tenantId}}' AND g.lot_v2_job_id = '{{node:code_node_LPguard.data.jobId}}' AND g.stock_movement_status = 'Processing' AND g.is_deleted = 0) AS linked_lot
  FROM (SELECT NOW(3) AS t) n
  LEFT JOIN gd_async_job j
    ON j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_LPguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND j.id = {{node:code_node_LPguard.data.jobId}}

script.code:
SELECT p.step_name, p.result_ref
  FROM gd_publish_step p
 WHERE p.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_LPentry.data.tenantId}}'
   AND p.job_id = '{{node:code_node_LPentry.data.jobId}}'
   AND p.step_name LIKE 'S|%'
   AND p.is_deleted = 0
 ORDER BY p.step_name

SELECT JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(h.id AS CHAR), 'stock_movement_no', h.stock_movement_no, 'stock_movement_no_type', CAST(h.stock_movement_no_type AS CHAR),
       'stock_movement_status', h.stock_movement_status, 'issuing_operation_faci', CAST(h.issuing_operation_faci AS CHAR),
       'receiving_operation_faci', CAST(h.receiving_operation_faci AS CHAR), 'organization_id', h.organization_id,
       'issue_date', DATE_FORMAT(h.issue_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), 'is_production_order', h.is_production_order, 'movement_type', h.movement_type,
       'movement_reason', h.movement_reason, 'issued_by', h.issued_by, 'tenant_id', h.tenant_id, 'lot_v2_job_id', CAST(h.lot_v2_job_id AS CHAR)) AS j
  FROM sm_location_transfer h
 WHERE h.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_LPentry.data.tenantId}}'
   AND h.id = {{node:code_node_LPentry.data.lotId}}
   AND h.is_deleted = 0

SELECT JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(l.id AS CHAR), 'line_index', l.line_index, 'item_selection', l.item_selection, 'item_name', l.item_name,
       'quantity_uom', CAST(l.quantity_uom AS CHAR), 'location_id', CAST(l.location_id AS CHAR), 'storage_location_id', CAST(l.storage_location_id AS CHAR),
       'temp_qty_data', l.temp_qty_data, 'total_quantity', l.total_quantity, 'organization_id', l.organization_id, 'issuing_plant', CAST(l.issuing_plant AS CHAR),
       'receiving_plant', CAST(l.receiving_plant AS CHAR), 'item_remark', l.item_remark, 'parent_id', CAST(l.parent_id AS CHAR),
       'item_bundle_id', l.item_bundle_id, 'requested_qty', l.requested_qty) AS j
  FROM sm_location_transfer_d2c7o1jd_sub l WHERE l.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_LPentry.data.tenantId}}' AND l.sm_location_transfer_id = {{node:code_node_LPentry.data.lotId}} AND l.is_deleted = 0
 ORDER BY CAST(l.line_index AS UNSIGNED), l.id

SELECT JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(t.id AS CHAR), 'doc_type', t.doc_type, 'doc_id', t.doc_id, 'doc_no', t.doc_no, 'doc_line_id', t.doc_line_id,
       'line_no', t.line_no, 'material_id', CAST(t.material_id AS CHAR), 'item_code', t.item_code, 'item_uom', CAST(t.item_uom AS CHAR),
       'batch_id', CAST(t.batch_id AS CHAR), 'handling_unit_id', t.handling_unit_id, 'plant_id', CAST(t.plant_id AS CHAR), 'organization_id', t.organization_id,
       'transit_bin', CAST(t.transit_bin AS CHAR), 'from_bin', CAST(t.from_bin AS CHAR), 'from_category', t.from_category, 'to_bin', CAST(t.to_bin AS CHAR),
       'to_category', t.to_category, 'transit_qty', CAST(t.transit_qty AS CHAR), 'received_qty', CAST(t.received_qty AS CHAR),
       'open_qty', CAST(t.open_qty AS CHAR), 'status', t.status, 'transit_date', DATE_FORMAT(t.transit_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'),
       'received_date', DATE_FORMAT(t.received_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')) AS j
  FROM in_transit_detail t
 WHERE t.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_LPentry.data.tenantId}}'
   AND t.doc_id = '{{node:code_node_LPentry.data.lotId}}'
   AND t.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_LPentry.data.organizationId}}'
   AND t.is_deleted = 0
 ORDER BY t.id

SELECT JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(i.id AS CHAR), 'material_code', i.material_code, 'material_name', i.material_name, 'material_desc', i.material_desc) AS j
  FROM item i
 WHERE i.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_LPentry.data.tenantId}}'
   AND i.is_deleted = 0
   AND i.id IN (SELECT CAST(l.item_selection AS UNSIGNED) FROM sm_location_transfer_d2c7o1jd_sub l WHERE l.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_LPentry.data.tenantId}}' AND l.sm_location_transfer_id = {{node:code_node_LPentry.data.lotId}} AND l.is_deleted = 0)
 ORDER BY i.id

SELECT JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(b.id AS CHAR), 'bin', b.bin_location_combine) AS j
  FROM bin_location b
 WHERE b.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_LPentry.data.tenantId}}'
   AND b.is_deleted = 0
   AND b.plant_id = (SELECT h.issuing_operation_faci FROM sm_location_transfer h WHERE h.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_LPentry.data.tenantId}}' AND h.id = {{node:code_node_LPentry.data.lotId}} AND h.is_deleted = 0)
 ORDER BY b.id

script.code:
SELECT JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(i.id AS CHAR), 'material_code', i.material_code, 'item_batch_management', i.item_batch_management,
       'stock_control', i.stock_control,
       'uom_conversion_json', CAST(COALESCE((SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('alt_uom_id', CAST(u.alt_uom_id AS CHAR), 'base_qty', u.base_qty))
                                             FROM item_mji552rc_sub u WHERE u.Item_id = i.id AND u.is_deleted = 0), '[]') AS CHAR),
       'default_bin_json', CAST(COALESCE((SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('plant_id', CAST(b.plant_id AS CHAR), 'bin_location', CAST(b.bin_location AS CHAR)))
                                          FROM item_wu520fpw_sub b WHERE b.Item_id = i.id AND b.is_deleted = 0), '[]') AS CHAR)) AS j
  FROM item i
 WHERE i.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_LPentry.data.tenantId}}'
   AND i.is_deleted = 0
   AND i.id IN (SELECT CAST(l.item_selection AS UNSIGNED) FROM sm_location_transfer_d2c7o1jd_sub l WHERE l.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_LPentry.data.tenantId}}' AND l.sm_location_transfer_id = {{node:code_node_LPentry.data.lotId}} AND l.is_deleted = 0 AND l.requested_qty > 0 AND COALESCE(l.item_selection,
		'') <> ''
                     AND ('{{node:code_node_LPentry.data.allocScope}}' = 'REQ' OR ('{{node:code_node_LPentry.data.allocScope}}' = 'EMPTY' AND (l.temp_qty_data IS NULL OR TRIM(l.temp_qty_data) IN ('',
		'[]')))))
 ORDER BY i.id

script.code:
SELECT x.k, x.j FROM (
SELECT 'IB' AS k, b.id AS sid, JSON_OBJECT('id', b.`id`, 'material_id', b.`material_id`, 'location_id', b.`location_id`, 'block_qty', b.`block_qty`, 'reserved_qty',
		b.`reserved_qty`, 'unrestricted_qty', b.`unrestricted_qty`, 'qualityinsp_qty', b.`qualityinsp_qty`, 'balance_quantity', b.`balance_quantity`, 'create_user', b.`create_user`,
		'create_dept', b.`create_dept`, 'create_time', SUBSTRING(DATE_FORMAT(b.`create_time`, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s.%f'), 1, 23), 'update_user', b.`update_user`, 'update_time',
		SUBSTRING(DATE_FORMAT(b.`update_time`, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s.%f'), 1, 23), 'is_deleted', b.`is_deleted`, 'tenant_id', b.`tenant_id`, 'plant_id', b.`plant_id`, 'organization_id',
		b.`organization_id`, 'intransit_qty', b.`intransit_qty`, 'material_uom', b.`material_uom`, 'sub_tenant_id', b.`sub_tenant_id`) AS j FROM item_balance b
 WHERE b.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_LPentry.data.tenantId}}' AND b.is_deleted = 0 AND b.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_LPentry.data.organizationId}}' AND b.plant_id = (SELECT h.issuing_operation_faci FROM sm_location_transfer h WHERE h.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_LPentry.data.tenantId}}' AND h.id = {{node:code_node_LPentry.data.lotId}} AND h.is_deleted = 0) AND b.material_id IN (SELECT CAST(l.item_selection AS UNSIGNED) FROM sm_location_transfer_d2c7o1jd_sub l WHERE l.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_LPentry.data.tenantId}}' AND l.sm_location_transfer_id = {{node:code_node_LPentry.data.lotId}} AND l.is_deleted = 0 AND l.requested_qty > 0 AND COALESCE(l.item_selection,
		'') <> ''
                     AND ('{{node:code_node_LPentry.data.allocScope}}' = 'REQ' OR ('{{node:code_node_LPentry.data.allocScope}}' = 'EMPTY' AND (l.temp_qty_data IS NULL OR TRIM(l.temp_qty_data) IN ('',
		'[]')))))
UNION ALL
SELECT 'IBB' AS k, bb.id AS sid, JSON_OBJECT('id', bb.`id`, 'material_id', bb.`material_id`, 'location_id', bb.`location_id`, 'block_qty', bb.`block_qty`, 'reserved_qty',
		bb.`reserved_qty`, 'unrestricted_qty', bb.`unrestricted_qty`, 'qualityinsp_qty', bb.`qualityinsp_qty`, 'balance_quantity', bb.`balance_quantity`, 'batch_id', bb.`batch_id`,
		'create_user', bb.`create_user`, 'create_dept', bb.`create_dept`, 'create_time', SUBSTRING(DATE_FORMAT(bb.`create_time`, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s.%f'), 1, 23), 'update_user',
		bb.`update_user`, 'update_time', SUBSTRING(DATE_FORMAT(bb.`update_time`, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s.%f'), 1, 23), 'is_deleted', bb.`is_deleted`, 'tenant_id', bb.`tenant_id`,
		'plant_id', bb.`plant_id`, 'organization_id', bb.`organization_id`, 'intransit_qty', bb.`intransit_qty`, 'material_uom', bb.`material_uom`, 'doc_date', DATE_FORMAT(bb.`doc_date`,
		'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), 'expired_date', DATE_FORMAT(bb.`expired_date`, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), 'manufacturing_date', DATE_FORMAT(bb.`manufacturing_date`, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'),
		'sub_tenant_id', bb.`sub_tenant_id`, 'remark3', bb.`remark3`, 'remark2', bb.`remark2`, 'remark', bb.`remark`) AS j FROM item_batch_balance bb
 WHERE bb.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_LPentry.data.tenantId}}' AND bb.is_deleted = 0 AND bb.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_LPentry.data.organizationId}}' AND bb.plant_id = (SELECT h.issuing_operation_faci FROM sm_location_transfer h WHERE h.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_LPentry.data.tenantId}}' AND h.id = {{node:code_node_LPentry.data.lotId}} AND h.is_deleted = 0) AND bb.material_id IN (SELECT CAST(l.item_selection AS UNSIGNED) FROM sm_location_transfer_d2c7o1jd_sub l WHERE l.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_LPentry.data.tenantId}}' AND l.sm_location_transfer_id = {{node:code_node_LPentry.data.lotId}} AND l.is_deleted = 0 AND l.requested_qty > 0 AND COALESCE(l.item_selection,
		'') <> ''
                     AND ('{{node:code_node_LPentry.data.allocScope}}' = 'REQ' OR ('{{node:code_node_LPentry.data.allocScope}}' = 'EMPTY' AND (l.temp_qty_data IS NULL OR TRIM(l.temp_qty_data) IN ('',
		'[]')))))
) x ORDER BY x.k, x.sid

SELECT p.step_name, p.result_ref
  FROM gd_publish_step p
 WHERE p.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_LPentry.data.tenantId}}'
   AND p.job_id = 'SMLT|{{node:code_node_LPentry.data.lotId}}'
   AND p.step_name LIKE 'LOCK|%'
   AND p.is_deleted = 0
 ORDER BY p.id DESC
 LIMIT 1
